description: The SQLite download ran successfully from a clean directory, and both first-party itch.io documents returned HTTP 200. Those captures make it possible to test a separate checkout route while Payhip activation terms remain unresolved. The next step is to verify whether itch.io permits the utility and its disclosed AI production, then establish what a Canadian seller would need to activate checkout. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown. Treasury shows zero available funds and no verified revenue.
